verses.1: If I speak in the languages of humans and angels, yet I have no love at all, then I just make dull noises or produce a hollow sound.
verses.2: And if I have prophecy and know all the mysteries, and if I have complete knowledge, yet if I don’t have love, then I am not truly worthy.
verses.3: And if I destroy all that I have, and if I give up my possessions so that I can eat, then I will gain nothing in terms of love.
verses.4: Love is long-lasting. Love is useful; it isn’t greedy. Love doesn’t run away or change over time. It’s natural.
verses.5: He doesn’t cause harm, he doesn’t demand things for himself, he doesn’t spread rumors or speak ill of others.
verses.6: He does not rejoice at the injustice, but he rejoices in the truth.
verses.7: Always stands firm, always believes, always hopes, always endures.
verses.8: Love never dies. Whether it’s prophecy or prophcy, they will be destroyed. Whether it’s language or speech, they will cease to exist. Whether it’s knowledge or understanding, it will also be destroyed.
verses.9: For we learn from various sources, and also prophesy based on those sources.
verses.10: And when that final stage is reached, it will be destroyed from within.
verses.11: When I was a child, I acted like a child; I behaved like a child. When I became an adult, I destroyed everything related to being a child.
verses.12: For we see them now, as they stand before us in their full glory. Then I recognize their faces one by one; then I truly understand them, just as if I were awakened from a deep sleep.
verses.13: Now, there remains faith, hope, and love. Of these three, love is the most important.
